title: MR.DIY Opens 10 New Stores Across Malaysia
summary: MR.DIY continues its nationwide retail expansion with 10 new outlets this quarter, focusing on neighbourhood convenience and everyday value.
body:
Expansion highlights

MR.DIY has opened 10 new stores nationwide this quarter as part of its retail growth plan.

The rollout covers major cities and growing suburban catchments, making home essentials closer for families.

Where we opened

  • Kuala Lumpur & Selangor — 4 stores
  • Johor — 2 stores
  • Penang — 2 stores
  • East Malaysia — 2 stores

What shoppers can expect

  1. Wider assortment of home, DIY, and lifestyle products
  2. Everyday low prices on frequently bought items
  3. Friendly in-store service for project advice

Learn more on the official site: mrdiy.com.
seo_description: MR.DIY expands with 10 new stores in Malaysia

title: MR.DIY Festive Value Campaign: Home Ready for Celebration
summary: A multi-week campaign that helps households prepare for festive gatherings with affordable essentials — from kitchenware to storage and décor.
body:
Campaign overview

The Home Ready for Celebration campaign focuses on affordable home essentials for families preparing for festive seasons.

Shoppers can find curated picks across kitchen, storage, cleaning, and décor categories — without overspending.

Featured categories

  • Kitchen ready: cookware, utensils, food containers
  • Smart storage: organisers, boxes, hangers
  • Fresh finish: cleaning tools and décor accents

How to join

  1. Visit any participating MR.DIY store during the campaign period
  2. Look for the festive value tags on selected items
  3. Check weekly flyer updates for bundle deals

Terms apply. Details available in-store and at mrdiy.com/campaigns.
seo_description: Discover MR.DIY festive home essentials deals

title: MR.DIY Sustainability Update: Less Waste, More Value
summary: An update on packaging reduction, reusable product ranges, and store-level recycling pilots that support a lower-waste shopping experience.
body:
Why it matters

Customers want products that last longer and create less waste. This update summarises MR.DIY initiatives across product design, packaging, and store operations.

Product & packaging

  • More refillable and reusable household items in selected categories
  • Reduced excess packaging on high-volume SKUs where feasible
  • Clearer on-pack guidance for recycling where local facilities exist

Store pilots

Selected stores are testing collection points for soft plastics and battery drop-off partnerships with local recycling partners.

"Small changes in everyday shopping add up — better products, less waste, same everyday value."

What comes next

  1. Expand reusable ranges in more regions
  2. Share quarterly progress with store teams
  3. Continue supplier conversations on packaging efficiency

Questions? Contact your local store team or visit mrdiy.com/sustainability.
seo_description: MR.DIY packaging and recycling initiatives for less waste
